Grid.verticalSpacing | let verticalSpacing: Int
GridItem | struct GridItem
GridItem.Size | enum Size
GridItem.Size.adaptive(minimum:maximum:) | case adaptive(minimum: Int, maximum: Int = .max)
GridItem.Size.fixed(_:) | case fixed(Int)
GridItem.Size.flexible(minimum:maximum:) | case flexible(minimum: Int = 1, maximum: Int = .max)
GridItem.alignment | var alignment: Alignment?
GridItem.init(_:spacing:alignment:) | init(_ size: GridItem.Size = .flexible(), spacing: Int? = nil, alignment: Alignment? = nil)
GridItem.size | var size: GridItem.Size
GridItem.spacing | var spacing: Int?
